records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks for setting up Clearwater Partners on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield — how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Totally understandable — a busy stretch happens, and there's no rush on our end.

When you do get a window, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project; projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. If it's useful, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you live so it's done in one sitting — otherwise just reply here and I'll help with whatever step is next.

Best,
Chidi
